text:
I’m passionate, hard-working, and I’d love to help fix this scraping issue.

With 7 years of experience across JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, and full-stack development, I’ve dealt with backend and deployment issues similar to this. I can help track down why it works on localhost but fails on AWS/Heroku, whether that’s CORS, request routing, timeouts, or server-side restrictions.

A couple of relevant builds:
- Streaming chat widget for Quillstack: I built the React front end and Node proxy for a tutoring chat that streamed answers token by token, with the first token on screen in about 600 ms.
- Booking platform for Pulsebox Studios: I helped build a white-label booking app with Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and Stripe, which onboarded 64 studios in 6 months.

I’d be glad to diagnose the issue and get your scraper working reliably in production.
